title: blocker_a3ba1690 also gates load: k6 has no target on this machine, and the baseline fails red instead of skipping
body:
VERIFIED by running, 2026-08-23, from the load session:
  - Nothing listens on localhost:3000 (curl: connection refused).
  - ../wayfarer beside the hub checkout has .env.example but no .env.local, so it
    cannot be built here for the same reason ui gave in blocker_a3ba1690.
  - BASE_URL is unset in this session; no deployed target has been published.
  - k6 run -u 1 --duration 3s tests/load/baseline.js -> every request logs
    'dial tcp 127.0.0.1:3000: connect: connection refused'; http_req_failed
    trips its rate<0.01 threshold and the run exits non-zero.

WHY THIS IS WORTH A SEPARATE LINE: the lane skill says specs skip while
BASE_URL is unset. That is true of the Playwright lanes, not of k6. baseline.js
defaults BASE_URL to localhost:3000 and runs regardless, so a machine with no
app produces a RED run that is indistinguishable at a glance from a real
performance regression. Not raising a second blocker -- ui's covers it and
either of its two clearances (owner supplies .env.local, or a BASE_URL is
published) unblocks load identically. This entry is so the queue shows one
blocker gating two lanes, not one.

NOT DONE: I have not changed baseline.js. Proposed follow-up in my lane:
abort in setup() with a clear message when BASE_URL is unset, so 'no target'
reads as skipped rather than failed. Will do on hub's say-so.

title: k6 framework landed at 338797b: no-target runs skip with exit 0; smoke verified green against the deployment, 20/20 requests, p95 55ms
body:
DELIVERED at 338797b (framework) and 008bc73 (hook mode fix), both on lane/load.

STRUCTURE (all under tests/load/)
  lib/config.js   target resolution (BASE_URL only -- NO localhost default any
                  more), route tags (static|results), shared thresholds, and
                  the shared journeys visitStaticRoutes / visitResults.
  smoke.js        1 VU, 10s, prerendered routes ONLY (/ and /plan). A pulse
                  check, deliberately excluding server-rendered /results so it
                  stays harmless against a shared public target while the data
                  backend is down (blocker_a3ba1690). Lax duration budget:
                  smoke fails on failed requests, not slow ones.
  baseline.js     unchanged shape (30s ramp to 10 VUs, 1m hold, 30s down; all
                  routes; same budgets as before) refactored onto lib/config.js.
  stress.js       defined (ramp to 50 VUs, ~6 min) but GUARDED: refuses any
                  *.vercel.app host outright, and any other non-loopback host
                  unless STRESS_ALLOW_REMOTE=i-own-this-target is passed.
                  Local or dedicated targets only; no npm script on purpose.
  preflight.mjs   the approved skip mechanism. Node script: BASE_URL unset ->
                  SKIPPED, exit 0. Set -> GET <target>/ with a 10s timeout;
                  any HTTP status counts as alive (a target answering 500
                  should be measured red, not skipped); network-level failure
                  -> SKIPPED, exit 0. Alive -> exec k6 with the exit code
                  passed through, so threshold breaches still fail. k6 missing
                  while a target IS reachable exits 1: environment defect, not
                  a skip.

SCRIPTS: test:load = baseline via preflight; test:load:smoke added. Direct
k6 run without BASE_URL aborts in init with instructions (non-zero; the npm
scripts are the skip-safe path).

SKIP DEMO, verified by running, exit code echoed:
  npm run test:load        (BASE_URL unset)
  load tests SKIPPED -- no target: BASE_URL is not set
  SKIPPED is not a pass: 0 requests were sent, nothing was measured.
  To run: point BASE_URL at a reachable deployment, e.g. BASE_URL=<url> npm run test:load
  exit=0
Unreachable branch also verified: BASE_URL at a closed local port -> "target
... did not answer the preflight probe (ECONNREFUSED)", exit 0.

SMOKE VERIFIED against https://wayfarer-xi.vercel.app, 2026-08-24, by running
npm run test:load:smoke from the load session: exit 0, 11.5s wall, 10
iterations, 20 requests (10x GET /, 10x GET /plan) plus 1 preflight probe of
/. http_req_failed 0.00% (0 of 20); checks 20/20; http_req_duration avg
41.7ms, med 40.1ms, p95 54.9ms, max 55.8ms. All three thresholds passed.
/results was NOT touched, per task_b9db4231 and blocker_a3ba1690.

NOT DONE
  - baseline and stress have never executed under this refactor: no target can
    take them today (the deployment's /results 500s, and heavier profiles must
    not point at the public deployment regardless). Both parse clean under k6
    inspect, and the stress guards were verified to throw on *.vercel.app and
    on non-loopback hosts without the ack. The first real baseline run still
    owes the board a numbers entry.
  - baseline thresholds are carried over from the old file, not re-derived.
  - no stress npm script, by design; documented in stress.js.

title: pre-commit disclosure hook never ran in any worktree: committed non-executable (mode 100644); fixed at 008bc73 on lane/load
body:
VERIFIED by committing from the load worktree, 2026-08-24: git printed
"hint: The '.githooks/pre-commit' hook was ignored because it's not set as
executable" and ran no scan. git ls-files -s .githooks/pre-commit showed mode
100644 -- the executable bit was never committed (hook landed in 8ea68ef) --
so every commit in every lane worktree has silently bypassed the disclosure
gate since. core.hooksPath was set correctly; the mode bit was the whole
problem.

FIX: chmod +x committed as 008bc73 on lane/load (mode-only change). That
commit is its own proof: the hook fired and printed "disclosure scan: clean
(1 staged files)". Mode bits travel with the tree, so merging propagates the
fix to every checkout.

UNTIL MERGED: other lanes' commits are NOT scanned at commit time. The
full-tree scan (node bin/scan-secrets.mjs, also in test:board) still covers
tracked content after the fact. My framework commit 338797b went in through
this gap; I re-ran the full-tree scan afterwards: clean, 31 tracked files.

ACTION for hub: merge lane/load (or cherry-pick 008bc73) to main, then have
lanes merge main. Until their worktrees carry the fix, treat lane commits as
unscanned and rely on the full-tree scan.

title: npm run test:load and test:load:smoke exit 0 with a SKIPPED message when no target answers; non-zero always means measured failure
body:
GUARANTEE as of 338797b on lane/load. With BASE_URL unset, or set but not
answering a 10-second probe of its root at the network level, both scripts
print "load tests SKIPPED -- <reason>" plus "SKIPPED is not a pass: 0
requests were sent, nothing was measured." and exit 0 without invoking k6.
When the target answers -- any HTTP status, including 500 -- k6 runs and its
exit code is passed through. So a non-zero exit from these scripts always
means a measured failure (threshold breach or script error), never a missing
environment; CI can run them unconditionally.

Scope of each script:
  test:load          baseline profile: 10 VUs for 2 minutes across / , /plan
                     and /results. Needs the data backend up.
  test:load:smoke    1 VU for 10 seconds, prerendered routes only (/ and
                     /plan) -- safe to point at a shared public deployment.

Not covered by the guarantee: direct k6 invocation (aborts non-zero when
BASE_URL is unset, by design), and the stress profile, which refuses
*.vercel.app and non-loopback hosts without an explicit acknowledgement and
has no npm script.

title: npm run test:load / test:load:smoke resolve their target via the shared resolver and exit 0 SKIPPED for no-journeys, local-build resolution, or nothing answering; non-zero means measured failure or named misconfiguration
body:
GUARANTEE as of 231644e on lane/load. Revised in place for wave 2: the skip
principle and message shape are unchanged; the target now comes from the
shared resolver, and two skip cases are new (1 and 2).

TARGET SELECTION (contract_8f9d0915): TARGET env or targets/config.json
default; BASE_URL wins verbatim; BASE_URL=deployed resolves to the target's
deployedUrl; resolver notes are printed once.

SKIP CASES -- print "load tests SKIPPED -- <reason>" plus "SKIPPED is not a
pass: 0 requests were sent, nothing was measured." and exit 0 WITHOUT
invoking k6:
  1. the resolved target has no targets/<name>/load/journeys.json (checked
     before any traffic -- a journey-less target is never probed)
  2. resolution landed in local-build mode: the preflight never builds or
     starts apps, and probing the localUrl would load-test whatever
     unrelated service happens to hold that port (observed happening).
     Zero traffic; local runs are explicit -- start the app, pass BASE_URL.
  3. nothing answers a 10-second probe of the target root at the network
     level (explicit-url and deployed modes).
A target answering ANY HTTP status, 500 included, runs and is measured.

EXIT CODES: 0 = green run or SKIPPED (stdout says which, unmistakably).
1 = named misconfiguration on stderr: unknown profile, TargetError from the
resolver (unknown target, sentinel without deployedUrl, ...), or k6 missing
while a target is reachable. Any other value is k6's own exit code passed
through -- live-verified: a threshold-failing run propagated exit 99. CI can
run these scripts unconditionally.

SCOPE: test:load = baseline (10 VUs, 2 minutes, the target's "full" journey
set); test:load:smoke = 1 VU, 10 seconds, the target's "smoke" set -- for
wayfarer that is / and /plan only, /results excluded by data
(blocker_a3ba1690). Journey sets and budgets live at
targets/<name>/load/journeys.json; schema documented in
tests/load/lib/config.js.

NOT COVERED: direct k6 invocation (aborts non-zero without -e BASE_URL and
rejects the literal sentinel, with instructions), and the stress profile
(no npm script; refuses *.vercel.app outright and non-loopback hosts
without an explicit acknowledgement).

title: Wave 2 landed at 231644e: k6 engine is target-agnostic, wayfarer journeys are data, preflight resolves through the shared resolver; smoke green via the deployed sentinel
body:
DELIVERED at 231644e on lane/load (wave-1 base: 338797b).

THE SPLIT
  tests/load/{smoke,baseline,stress}.js + lib/config.js -- engine, no target
    knowledge: profile shapes, engine constants, schema validation.
  targets/wayfarer/load/journeys.json -- wayfarer data: groups "static"
    (/, /plan; budgetMs p95 300 / p99 800) and "results" (the canonical
    query shape; p95 800 / p99 2000); sets smoke=[static],
    full=[static,results]. Smoke excluding /results is wayfarer DATA citing
    blocker_a3ba1690 in its own file, not engine code.

JOURNEY MECHANISM (the documented call): journeys are JSON read at k6 init
via open() with a computed path. k6 module imports are static, so per-target
journey CODE cannot load dynamically; a generated entry file was the
alternative and lost on moving parts. VERIFIED on k6 v2.1.0 that open()
resolves relative to the calling module (tests/load/lib/config.js), not the
main script. Schema is documented in lib/config.js (the engine authority):
groups.<name>.paths, optional groups.<name>.budgetMs {p95,p99} becoming
http_req_duration{route:<name>} thresholds, sets.smoke / sets.full
membership; _comment keys ignored. k6 inspect confirms the generated
wayfarer thresholds are identical to wave-1's hardcoded ones.

PREFLIGHT + RESOLVER (contract_8f9d0915): resolveTarget() imported directly;
resolved BASE_URL and TARGET passed to k6 via -e; resolver note printed
once; TargetError exits 1 as one-line misconfiguration on stderr.

VERIFICATION MATRIX -- all by running from the load session, 2026-08-24,
exit codes captured directly:
  smoke vs deployment: BASE_URL=deployed npm run test:load:smoke -> exit 0,
    11.4s wall, 10 iterations, 20 requests = 10x GET / + 10x GET /plan,
    plus 1 probe of /. checks 20/20, http_req_failed 0.00%, p95 72.35ms
    (an earlier run the same hour: 53.19ms; both far under budget). Only
    route:static traffic; /results untouched. Sentinel resolution was
    exercised by this same run.
  TARGET=example -> SKIPPED "has no load journeys (expected
    targets/example/load/journeys.json)", exit 0, zero traffic; the
    deployedUrl-fallback note printed first, covering the note path.
  BASE_URL unset (wayfarer default) -> SKIPPED "resolved to local-build
    (http://localhost:3000) and the preflight does not build or start
    apps", exit 0, zero traffic. Wave-1 parity: same exit-0 SKIPPED
    semantics, new reason string.
  BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3999 -> SKIPPED (ECONNREFUSED), exit 0.
  TARGET=nonexistent -> resolver's one-line TargetError, exit 1.
  direct-k6 guards via k6 inspect: BASE_URL unset aborts with
    instructions; literal BASE_URL=deployed rejected as a sentinel;
    TARGET=example fails loudly naming the expected file; stress still
    refuses *.vercel.app and non-loopback-without-ack, parses with ack.
  test:board green from this worktree (includes the init-hub suite).

TWO DECISIONS TO KNOW ABOUT
  1. local-build resolutions SKIP with zero traffic -- the stricter of the
     two options the resolver contract offers load. The probing alternative
     was implemented first and bit immediately: an unrelated dev server on
     this machine answers localhost:3000, the probe accepted it, and a full
     2-minute baseline ran against it (211,758 iterations, http_req_failed
     66.66%, exit 99 -- which also live-verified threshold-failure exit
     passthrough). Local load runs are now one explicit BASE_URL away
     instead of accidental.
  2. The probe route stays the target root /, NOT target.json healthRoute,
     deviating from the wiring suggestion in contract_8f9d0915: the probe
     asks "is anything listening" (any HTTP status means run and measure),
     not "is the stack healthy" (the api health gate's question), and
     wayfarer's healthRoute is its known-broken /results shape while
     blocker_a3ba1690 stands -- a route load traffic must not touch on the
     public deployment.

CONTRACT: contract_feda9def revised in place for the two new skip cases and
resolver-based selection; skip principle and message shape unchanged.

NOT DONE
  - baseline and stress still have no legitimate full run anywhere:
    /results is down (blocker_a3ba1690) and heavier profiles stay off the
    public deployment. Budgets carry over from wave 1, still not re-derived
    from a real run.
  - example intentionally has no journeys; it proves the skip path, not a
    run. No second target with journeys has been exercised end to end.
  - no engine README; the journeys.json schema documentation lives in
    tests/load/lib/config.js and this entry. If docs lane wants it in the
    target-onboarding template, the schema block in config.js is the source.

ACTION for hub: mark task_16c3eb07 done (the CLI refuses lane closure of a
hub-owned entry; this finding is the completion signal).

title: npm run test:load / test:load:smoke resolve their target via the shared resolver and exit 0 SKIPPED for no-journeys, local-build resolution, or nothing answering; non-zero means measured failure or named misconfiguration
body:
GUARANTEE as of 231644e on lane/load. Revised in place for wave 2: the skip
principle and message shape are unchanged; the target now comes from the
shared resolver, and two skip cases are new (1 and 2).

TARGET SELECTION (contract_8f9d0915): TARGET env or targets/config.json
default; BASE_URL wins verbatim; BASE_URL=deployed resolves to the target's
deployedUrl; resolver notes are printed once.

SKIP CASES -- print "load tests SKIPPED -- <reason>" plus "SKIPPED is not a
pass: 0 requests were sent, nothing was measured." and exit 0 WITHOUT
invoking k6:
  1. the resolved target has no targets/<name>/load/journeys.json (checked
     before any traffic -- a journey-less target is never probed)
  2. resolution landed in local-build mode: the preflight never builds or
     starts apps, and probing the localUrl would load-test whatever
     unrelated service happens to hold that port (observed happening).
     Zero traffic; local runs are explicit -- start the app, pass BASE_URL.
  3. nothing answers a 10-second probe of the target root at the network
     level (explicit-url and deployed modes).
A target answering ANY HTTP status, 500 included, runs and is measured.

EXIT CODES: 0 = green run or SKIPPED (stdout says which, unmistakably).
1 = named misconfiguration on stderr: unknown profile, TargetError from the
resolver (unknown target, sentinel without deployedUrl, ...), or k6 missing
while a target is reachable. Any other value is k6's own exit code passed
through -- live-verified: a threshold-failing run propagated exit 99. CI can
run these scripts unconditionally.

SCOPE: test:load = baseline (10 VUs, 2 minutes, the target's "full" journey
set); test:load:smoke = 1 VU, 10 seconds, the target's "smoke" set -- for
wayfarer that is / and /plan only, /results excluded by data
(blocker_a3ba1690). Journey sets and budgets live at
targets/<name>/load/journeys.json; schema documented in
tests/load/lib/config.js.

NOT COVERED: direct k6 invocation (aborts non-zero without -e BASE_URL and
rejects the literal sentinel, with instructions), and the stress profile
(no npm script; refuses *.vercel.app outright and non-loopback hosts
without an explicit acknowledgement).

RE-PROVED CONTINUOUSLY as of b108d43: test/load-preflight.sh in test:board
re-verifies every skip clause, both exit-1 misuse cases, the verbatim
"SKIPPED is not a pass" line, and all direct-k6 guards (via k6 inspect,
zero requests) on every run -- loopback-only, CI-safe. Exempt from V&V
tagging as a harness contract (finding_91c92a9e).

title: Skip-semantics regression suite landed at b108d43: 28 loopback-only checks in test:board re-prove every preflight skip clause and direct-k6 guard on every run
body:
DELIVERED at b108d43 on lane/load: test/load-preflight.sh, appended to the
test:board chain in package.json. The audit's gap was real -- every skip
clause of contract_feda9def existed only as an author demo quoted in a
finding; now the gate re-proves them on every run.

28 CHECKS, all verified by running the suite (twice: standalone and inside
npm run test:board -- gate green, 83 PASS lines total across all suites):
  14 node-level, always run:
    - local-build resolution skips exit 0, names the mode, zero traffic (3)
    - journey-less target (example) skips exit 0 naming the expected
      targets/example/load/journeys.json, resolver fallback note printed (4)
    - closed loopback port skips exit 0 naming the probe; the port is bound
      ephemerally then released so the number is known-dead -- no magic
      port constants (3)
    - unknown TARGET exits 1 with the resolver's named error; unknown
      profile exits 1 naming the valid ones (4)
    - every skip case asserts the verbatim "SKIPPED is not a pass: 0
      requests were sent, nothing was measured." line, so message-shape
      drift fails the gate
  14 direct-k6, via k6 inspect ONLY (init parse, zero requests), SKIP
  visibly with a count when k6 is absent:
    - no-BASE_URL abort; literal BASE_URL=deployed rejected as sentinel (4)
    - stress refuses *.vercel.app; refuses non-loopback without ack; parses
      WITH the ack (5)
    - all three profiles parse the wayfarer journeys via open() -- guards
      the data-file wiring itself (3)
    - direct k6 on a journey-less target fails loudly naming the file (2)

CI-SAFETY, verified by construction and by reading the transcript of a run:
the only sockets touched are 127.0.0.1 (one connect attempt to a known-dead
port); no k6 profile executes; no deployment sees a byte. Suite behaves the
same with BASE_URL/TARGET exported in the caller's shell (env -u hygiene).

CONTRACT: contract_feda9def revised in place with a RE-PROVED CONTINUOUSLY
section citing b108d43; stays open as the living guarantee, exempt from V&V
tagging as harness per finding_91c92a9e.

NOT DONE
  - The suite proves skip/guard semantics, not measurement: no committed
    check runs an actual k6 profile (that requires a target and traffic,
    which CI must not have). The green-path exec/k6-exit-passthrough clause
    remains verified only by the wave-1/wave-2 live runs in
    finding_8ebdceb4 / finding_9532feb8.
  - k6-absent machines skip 14 checks visibly; nothing simulates a missing
    k6 on machines that have it (the ENOENT exit-1 branch of the preflight
    is still author-verified only).
